title: Global Spherical Shells on Minimal Surfaces of Class VII
summary: We prove the Global Spherical Shell conjecture: every connected minimal compact complex surface of class VII with positive second Betti number contains a global spherical shell. This is a holomorphically embedded neighborhood of the standard three-sphere in $`\mathbb C^2\setminus\{0\}`$ whose complement is connected.

review.reason: Proves existence of global spherical shells in minimal class VII surfaces, resolving a conjecture.
